title: Northbeam TechWorks Haul-Away Charges by Service
content:
Taking the old item away is part of some Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair services and a separate charge under others. Two figures are carried per TechWorks service: the charge to take the old item away, and whether taking it away is included in the service.

| TechWorks service | Charge to take the old item away, USD | Taking it away included in the service |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 0.00 | no |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 0.00 | no |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 0.00 | no |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 39.00 | yes |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 0.00 | no |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 25.00 | yes |

Only two of the six TechWorks services include taking the old item away: the appliance service, which carries a charge of 39.00 USD for it, and the annual care service, which carries 25.00 USD. Under the four services that do not include it — the bench service, the standard home installation service, the calibration service and the business deployment service — the charge stands at 0.00.
